A. Guess the Number
time limit per test
1 second
memory limit per test
64 megabytes
input
standard input
output
standard output

This is an interactive problem. Guess a hidden number $$$x$$$ with $$$1 \le x \le 10^9$$$.

Display: $$$$$$x^2 + 1$$$$$$

Input

The first line contains $$$n$$$.

Output

Print queries.

Interaction

Print ? y and flush.

Examples
Input
3
1 2 3
Output
6
Input
1
  5
Output
5
